en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a two-story wooden building identified as 'Hotel Alexander.' There are signs in both Russian (Гостиница Александров) and German/English (HOTEL ALEXANDER) above the entrance. The building is situated on a corner, with horse-drawn carriages and several people visible outside. The postcard also includes printed text 'Werro.' at the top left, and 'Verlag von F. Karlson’s Buchhandlung, Werro.' at the bottom.
